sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the convict/appellant submits that the appellant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

He submits that as per prosecution case, complainant/father of the victim has lodged the report that his daughter who is aged about 16 years is missing, after investigation, it is alleged that the applicant has kidnapped and established physical relationship with the prosecutrix.
He also submits that on her own will, the prosecutrix eloped with the appellant.
He also submits that the MLC reports was also found negative in this case.

Learned counsel for the appellant further submits that during trial the appellant was on bail and after his conviction he is in jail since 11.09.2023 and the appeal is likely to take a couple of years or even more for its final disposal, hence he prays that the appellant be enlarged on bail

The learned counsel for the State/respondent has objected the bail application and submits that without obtaining permission from the parents of the prosecutrix the appellant took her with him and established physical relationship with her.

Therefore, the learned Trial Court, after appreciating the evidence on record and after examining the cross- examination of the witnesses, came to the conclusion regarding guilty of the accused, which is just and proper however he fairly submits that the appellant has no previous criminal antecedent.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records of the Court below.

Considering the facts & circumstance of the case particularly considering the fact that the prosecutrix had voluntarily eloped with the appellant and considering the facts that the MLC reports was found negative in this case and further during the course of trial, the appellant herein was on bail and had never misused the liberty during bail period

; the appellant is in jail since 11.09.2023 and hearing of this appeal would take some time, we deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, the substantive jail sentence awarded to appellant- Ajay Kumar Raut by the learned trial Court is hereby suspended.
He shall be released on bail his executing bail bond to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 13.12.2023.

He shall thereafter appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to them by the said Court, interval being not less than 6 months, till final disposal of this appeal.
Consequently, I.A. No. 1 of 2023 stands disposed of.

It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only confined for disposal of aforesaid I.A. and it shall not be construed as an expression of opinion of this Court on the merits of the matter.
List this matter for final hearing.
Certified copy, as per rules.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) (Ramesh Sinha)
